approach: Precompute the nearest non-zero values on both sides using left-to-right and right-to-left passes.
observation: Every stagnant section (0) relies solely on the nearest non-zero element to its left and right, regardless of how many 0s lie between them.
bruteForce: For each 0, scan left and right dynamically to locate nearest non-zero elements. Worst case O(N^2).
optimalSolution:
1. Perform a left-to-right pass to maintain the last seen non-zero value in leftNonZero[i].
2. Perform a right-to-left pass to maintain the last seen non-zero value in rightNonZero[i].
3. Iterate i from 0 to N-1: if C[i] == 0, compare |leftNonZero[i]| and |rightNonZero[i]| and copy the dominant value.
dryRun:
N = 5, C = [2, 0, -3, 0, 5].
leftNonZero = [null, 2, 2, -3, -3]
rightNonZero = [-3, -3, 5, 5, null]
For i=1: left=2, right=-3. |-3| > |2| => -3.
For i=3: left=-3, right=5. |5| > |-3| => 5.
edgeCases: Equal absolute values on left and right
